standing: Lead proposal, D3a-3 r2: the owner of each obligation this unit leaves open. The coordinator confirms or reassigns each at assent; the integrate script records them in the unit assent.

obligations.obligation: Resolve StageKind as a member-listed table (the Plan law's stage vocabulary as a generated-contract or protocol-enum table), so that provider.stage.changed, provider.stage.terminal and supervision.progress.absent can be registered.
obligations.proposedOwner: An S-OP-2 successor naming the source, with the Plan law (M3-C) supplying the members; D3 then registers the events ordinarily.

obligations.obligation: Resolve ProviderState (provider.stage.changed's state) from P3T and T2O's pinned state tables, or a reduced closed subset listed in full.
obligations.proposedOwner: An S-OP-2 successor, citing D2b-2's pinned P3T/T2O tables (M3-D D2b owner).

obligations.obligation: Resolve Signal (provider.process.reaped.signal; host.signal.received) as a member-listed table per supported platform.
obligations.proposedOwner: An S-OP-2 successor, with OPP section 5.5 and M3-D items 18-19 for the members; D3 then registers provider.process.reaped.

obligations.obligation: Resolve ProviderReason (provider.stage.terminal.reason): which pinned terminal-reason enums, or their union, it is.
obligations.proposedOwner: M3-L's next revision, or an S-OP-2 successor.

obligations.obligation: Adopt supervision.child.settled for item 21's two-segment supervision.settled (LD-D3A3-11).

Build and emit each RecordFact's registry event with the minted scope, universe and pid (LD-D3A3-1), on the identity set RecordFact::requires names; run S-OP-2 C-4's sinks and C-12's persisted read-back over the real emitter.
Produce supervision.cancel.forced and supervision.tree.swept facts (registered here, no D3a producer).

Re-run the gate, records and D3a-1/D3a-2 controls with D2b-3's and D2b-4's codecs; and widen or justify the tests' shortened 2 s handshake, which missed under the lane's parallel load at base (12 isolation-flaky tests).
